column1: # zap-baseline.py rules for the ottr board scan (.github/workflows/audit.yml, job zap).
# Format: <rule id><TAB><IGNORE|WARN|FAIL><TAB><comment>. The baseline scan already reports
# every rule as WARN; this file names the header and cookie rules the first triage is about.
# Next step: after the first triage, promote the header and cookie rules to FAIL and drop
# the -I flag from the two zap-baseline.py calls, so a warning fails the job.
# The session cookie is set by POST /api/setup and POST /api/login only (src/auth.ts:
# HttpOnly, Path=/, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age on login, Secure only on public hosts).
